lossless_tree_fields.enumeration: insertion order preserved; duplicate keys impossible post-parse (host JSON semantics: last wins); numeric-like keys keep host order
lossless_tree_fields.null_presence: explicit null vs absent distinguished; no undefined in parsed domain
lossless_tree_fields.numbers: f64 bits exact; exponent/negative-zero/nonfinite forms distinguished
lossless_tree_fields.paths: source paths as UTF-16 strings; NUL/newlines/escapes preserved
lossless_tree_fields.provenance: host JSON.parse is the reference; syntax diagnostics stay host-side; P03.2 transfer must not re-parse or canonicalize
